METALWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Gas Welding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Gas Welding.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Gas Welding.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Gas Welding.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Gas Welding.

2. When learning Centre La, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Centre La.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Centre La.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Centre La.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Centre La.

3. When learning Project 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 2.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 2.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Project 2.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 2.

4. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

6. When learning Heat treatment of steel, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Heat treatment of steel.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Heat treatment of steel.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Heat treatment of steel.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Heat treatment of steel.

7. When learning Metalwork related businesses, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork related businesses.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork related businesses.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork related businesses.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork related businesses.

8. When learning Project 1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 1.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 1.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 1.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Project 1.

9. When learning Assembly Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawings.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawings.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawings.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawings.

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

12. When learning Surface Finishing Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Finishing Processes.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Surface Finishing Processes.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Finishing Processes.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Finishing Processes.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Career Opportunities in Metalwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Metalwork related businesses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Heat treatment of steel and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Centre La and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
